title: The 4 Best Space Heaters Under $100
metaDescription: Our 4 picks for space heaters under $100, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at space heaters under $100 using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Dreo Solaris 317 Space Heater
products.blurb: Key specs: 1500W PTC ceramic heating element, 70-degree oscillation, 34dB whisper-quiet brushless DC motor.
strengths: Quietest fan of any heaterat this price, at just 34dB
70-degree oscillation covers more of a room than fixed-direction competitors
Precise 1°F thermostat steps hold a steady temperature better than dial-based models
limitations: More expensive than basic tower heaters without matching wattage
Plastic housing feels lighter-duty than a metal radiator
No oil-filled residual heat retention after shutoff

products.name: De'Longhi Dragon Digital Oil-Filled Radiator TRD40615EBK
products.blurb: Key specs: 1500W oil-filled radiator, 75% more radiant surface area design, Digital display and programmable timer.
strengths: Silent, fanless operation unlike every ceramic heater in this list
Retains warmth for a while after shutting off
ECO mode helps manage running cost over long sessions

products.name: Vornado VH202 Personal Space Heater
products.blurb: Key specs: Vortex heat circulation fan, Cool-touch exterior, Compact footprint.
strengths: Best-suited option here for under-desk or personal-zone heating
Cool-touch housing is safer for close-range use than exposed models
limitations: Not built to heat a large room on its own

products.name: Lasko 5572 Oscillating Ceramic Tower Heater
products.blurb: Key specs: 29-inch oscillating tower, Logic Center digital remote, Adjustable thermostat.
strengths: Tallest tower in this list, spreading heat across a wider vertical area
limitations: Only 2 fixed heat settings, not a stepless thermostat

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
